message.content: {"calls": [{"tool": "chest_xray_classifier", "source_filename": "figures/8683/figure_1.jpg", "reason": "To obtain normalized scores for pulmonary vascular findings and cardiac silhouette size relevant to chronic PE and pulmonary hypertension."}, {"tool": "chest_xray_report_generator", "source_filename": "figures/8683/figure_1.jpg", "reason": "To generate a detailed textual description of pulmonary artery prominence, laterality (right vs left descending), and cardiac silhouette dimensions to distinguish between the specific options provided."}], "reason": "The question requires distinguishing between subtle variations in pulmonary artery enlargement (normal vs mild vs severe) and cardiac silhouette size.
